trigger.message: PFCP message with a non-null-terminated Node ID
trigger.field: ogs_pfcp_node_id_to_string_static() calls strlen() on a non-null-terminated node_id buffer -> reads past the 257-byte 'node_id' stack buffer in pfcp_recv_cb
trigger.precondition: None — runs in pfcp_recv_cb on receive (pre-association)

ground_truth.crash_type: stack-buffer-overflow (READ size 260 via strlen; reads past 257-byte 'node_id' in pfcp_recv_cb frame)

root_cause.note: Same node_id[257] stack buffer in pfcp_recv_cb as OPEN5GS-PFCP-006 (#3839). 006 = WRITE overflow via ogs_pfcp_extract_node_id; this = READ overflow via ogs_pfcp_node_id_to_string_static. Distinct functions, distinct bugs.
